turns.utterance: is Zoom auto-provisioned at the company or do I need to request access?
turns.reply:
Got it—you’re asking whether Zoom is automatically set up for you or if you need to request it.

For Zoom (meetings/chat), I don’t have a knowledge article result that confirms whether it’s auto-provisioned company-wide. For Zoom Phone, access depends on your role and you can quickly check whether it’s already enabled for you:

Open the Zoom desktop app.
Look for the Phone tab at the top.
If you don’t see it, click More and select Phone.
If Phone still doesn’t appear, request access using the steps here: https://indeed.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ITKB/pages/752324540
(Direct request form: https://indeed.atlassian.net/servicedesk/customer/portal/1/group/1041/create/1169)

Note: For many client-facing Sales/CS/SBS roles, Zoom Phone is typically granted by default; for other roles, a request is usually required.
